prior_to_rotation: Review Master Elective Spreadsheet on resident website
Develop plan with mentor: location, schedule, supervisor, brief description and objectives
Non-UH supervisor: email Melvyna Williams for affiliation agreement
Submit elective request form + mentor approval email to Dr. Andrew Hunt ≥6 weeks before start
PGY3/4/PPP electives: coordinate through Dr. Kathleen Cerny
overview: Flexible educational experience — block (often 2-week) or longitudinal (half-day to 1.5 days/week for PGY3/4). 62 catalogued options across adult, CAP, CL, college, community, forensic, geriatric, integrated, interventional, scholarly, senior, substance use, and women's mental health. Residents may be cross-covered for required services; remain in town unless backup arranged.
logistics: PGY1: often 2-week blocks; study/reading for Step 3/Level 3; QI or research electives
PGY2: ~6 weeks in 2-week blocks — forensic shadowing, interventional (ECT/TMS/ketamine), specialty clinics
PGY3/4: mostly longitudinal outpatient-style electives; fast-track CAP affects availability
Active vs observational varies by site — confirm in catalog row before planning ILP evidence
Longitudinal electives may count toward outpatient requirements when noted in catalog
debrief_prompts: What competency did this elective develop that your core rotations did not?
One patient or system interaction that belongs in your ILP or career narrative
If longitudinal: how did continuity change your formulation or alliance?
Scholarship or QI product emerging from the elective?
